what: the day's ranked clusters, in the desk's own one line, sources counted and linked (Jack, 5 October 2026)
what_a_wire_line_is: Each line is the desk's own one-line summary of a story it ranked, with its sources counted and linked. It is not a story the desk wrote or checked; only the item with a badge was checked.

checked.says: Decrypt reports Tether signed a memorandum of understanding with Kazakhstan's National Bank and Alatau City Authority to explore a tenge-pegged stablecoin and tokenized assets, with pilots planned.
checked.unconfirmed: Timeline for pilot launch and which party would issue the stablecoin token are stated as unspecified in the MOU itself.
